title: eni.it
description:
Contracts and Commercial Relationships — 7,105 unique files (18.78 GB): signed contracts, customer and supplier agreements, agreements with ENI, service contracts, and agency agreements.
Finance and Accounting — 28,562 files (1.91 GB): invoices, payments, tax filings, balance sheets, commissions, revenue records, banking documents, and accounting records.
Public Procurement and Tenders — 3,041 files (1.13 GB): CONSIP, ODA, tender documentation, public-sector contracts, competitive bids, and tender results.
Legal Matters and Litigation — 939 files (0.72 GB): claims, litigation proceedings, legal correspondence, asset seizures, inspections, and enforcement proceedings.
Counterparty Due Diligence and Anti-Corruption Materials — Due Diligence documents relating to Tirion and SEII SUD, counterparty questionnaires, anti-corruption declarations, and sub-agent screening records.
Personal Data and HR — 1,092 HR files and 479 GDPR- and privacy-related files: payroll records, personnel documents, employment relationships, personal data, and customer databases.
Confidential Information — 570 unique files containing references to riservato, segreto, or confidenziale (Italian terms for restricted, secret, or confidential): restricted correspondence, commercial proposals, financial records, and tax documents.
